name: CES 5325 左翼撞击 三号熄火 冲出跑道

cards.audioText: B: You are the pilot of China Eastern 325 which is bound for Wuhan. You have just been handed over from Hefei Control, you are over IKUBA at 23, and your level is 8400 meters, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你是飞往武汉的 China Eastern 325 飞行员。你刚从合肥管制移交过来，23 在 IKUBA 上空，高度 8400 米，呼叫武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES5325, over IKUBA at 23, maintain 8400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES5325，23 在 IKUBA 上空，保持 8400 米。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, Wuhan Control, radar identified, descent to and maintain 6000 meters, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，武汉管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 6000 米，报告到达。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, descend to and maintain 6000 meters, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，下降并保持 6000 米，CES5325。

cards.audioText: B: You have just followed your TCAS RA instruction. You have stopped your descent at nearly 6800 meters and track out 9 kilometers right of the course, report to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你刚按 TCAS RA 指令执行。你在约 6800 米停止下降，并向航路右侧偏出 9 公里，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES5325, our TCAS instructed us to stop descent at 6800 meters, and we are tracking out 9 km right of the course.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES5325，我们的 TCAS 指令我们在 6800 米停止下降，并正向航路右侧偏出 9 公里。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, China Eastern 325, you have just passed the traffic, descent to 6000 meters and turn left heading 170 immediately, there is military activity in the area right now.
cards.audioTextZh: C：收到，China Eastern 325，你刚通过冲突飞机，下降至 6000 米并立即左转航向 170，该区域现在有军事活动。
cards.referenceText: Roger, descend to 6000 meters and turn left heading 170 immediately, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，下降至 6000 米并立即左转航向 170，CES5325。

cards.audioText: B: You hear a loud bang, it seems that the left wing has been hit by something, and you feel the airplane has a banking tendency. Declare Urgency to ATC and request priority landing and emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你听到一声巨响，似乎左翼被什么东西击中，并感觉飞机有坡度趋势。向 ATC 宣布紧急情况并请求优先着陆和应急服务。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CES5325, the left wing was hit by some foreign object, and the plane has a banking tendency. Request priority landing and emergency services.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，武汉管制，CES5325，左翼被某个外来物击中，飞机有坡度趋势。请求优先着陆和应急服务。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, roger PAN. Descend to and maintain 4800 meters, report passing X-Ray Sierra Hotel.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，收到 PAN。下降并保持 4800 米，报告通过 X-Ray Sierra Hotel。
cards.referenceText: Continue descend to 4800 meters, report passing XSH, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 4800 米，报告通过 XSH，CES5325。

cards.audioText:
C: China Eastern 325, we have notified the other relevant parties, please give us more description about your present situation.
B: Report to ATC that No.3 engine has flamed out and it is even harder to overcome the banking tendency. You guess that might be some more damages to the left wing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 325，我们已通知其他相关单位，请给我们更多你当前情况的描述。
B：向 ATC 报告 3 号发动机已熄火，克服坡度趋势更加困难。你猜测左翼可能还有更多损伤。
cards.referenceText: No.3 engine has flamed out and it is even harder to overcome the banking tendency, we suspect there might be some more damages to the left wing, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 3 号发动机已熄火，克服坡度趋势更加困难，我们怀疑左翼可能还有更多损伤，CES5325。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, keep us advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，随时通报。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，CES5325。

cards.audioText: B: Now, you are over X-Ray Sierra Hotel at 4800 meters, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 X-Ray Sierra Hotel 上空，高度 4800 米，呼叫武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES5325, over XSH at 4800 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES5325，XSH 上空，高度 4800 米。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, maintain present level and contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，保持当前高度，联系武汉进近118.9，再见。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present level, 118.9, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，118.9，CES5325。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over X-Ray Sierra Hotel at 4800 meters, call Wuhan Approach and inform them that you are in distress now.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 X-Ray Sierra Hotel 上空，高度 4800 米，呼叫武汉进近并告知他们你现在处于遇险状态。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, CES5325, we have been struck by foreign object, No.3 engine flame out and the aircraft tends to bank, we are now passing XSH at 4800 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，武汉进近，CES5325，我们被外来物击中，3 号发动机熄火，飞机有坡度趋势，我们现在通过 XSH，高度 4800 米。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, roger MAYDAY, the center controller as told us your situation, you will have the top priority. Descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1008, expect ILS approach runway 36 right, you are number 1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，收到 MAYDAY，管制中心已告诉我们你的情况，你将有最高优先级。QNH 1008 下降至 1200 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，你是第 1 架。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1008, ILS approach runway 36R, No.1, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: QNH 1008 下降至 1200 米，ILS 进近跑道 36R，第 1 架，CES5325。

cards.audioText: B: Now you want to verify the wind data, ask ATC to give detailed wind information.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你想核实风数据，请 ATC 提供详细风信息。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES5325, request wind information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES5325，请求风信息。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, eh, let me see, the latest ATIS shows, wind 310 degrees, at 11 meters per second, but it is variable.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，呃，让我看看，最新 ATIS 显示，风 310 度，11 米/秒，但风向不定。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CES5325。

cards.audioText: B: You consider there might be some problem with your landing, so you ask ATC to provide emergency assistance upon you landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你认为着陆可能有问题，所以请求 ATC 在你着陆时提供应急协助。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES5325, request emergency assistance upon our landing due to possible landing problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES5325，因可能存在着陆问题，请求着陆时应急协助。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, roger, well, fire services and ambulance will be ready upon you landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，收到，嗯，消防和救护车将在你着陆时准备好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CES5325。

cards.audioText: B: Now, you have fully established on the ILS runway 36 right, call Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完全建立跑道 36R ILS，呼叫武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES5325, established on the ILS runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES5325，已建立跑道 36R ILS。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, continue approach and contact Tower 118.6, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，继续进近，联系塔台 118.6，再见。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach and contact Tower 118.6, good day, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近并联系塔台 118.6，再见，CES5325。

cards.audioText: B: Now contact Tower, report to air traffic control that you are on emergency landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在联系塔台，向空中交通管制报告你正在紧急着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5325, we are on emergency landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES5325，我们正在紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, radar identified, continue ILS approach runway 36 right, you are No.1, report the outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，雷达识别，继续 ILS 进近跑道 36R，你是第 1 架，报告外指点标。
cards.referenceText: Continue ILS approach runway 36R, we are No.1, report the outer marker, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续 ILS 进近跑道 36R，我们是第 1 架，报告外指点标，CES5325。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over the outer marker, call Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在外指点标上空，呼叫武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5325, over outer marker.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES5325，外指点标上空。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 325, cleared land runway 36 right, wind 300 degrees at 12 meters per second, QNH 1008.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 325，跑道 36R 可以落地，风 300 度，12 米/秒，QNH 1008。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 36R, QNH 1008, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 可以落地，QNH 1008，CES5325。

cards.audioText: B: You have just skidded off the runway but managed to stop the aircraft on the grass strip, report to ATC and request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你刚滑出跑道，但设法将飞机停在草地带上，向 ATC 报告并请求应急服务。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5325, we skidded off the runway and manage to stop the aircraft on the grass, request emergency services.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES5325，我们滑出跑道并设法将飞机停在草地上，请求应急服务。
